final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_avg_wins FROM step1) SELECT step1.raceId, step1.avg_points, step1.avg_wins, step1.avg_wins - step2.avg_avg_wins AS difference FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
